item.description: Serbia's Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat in an historic election on Sunday following a near to 70% turnout at polling stations – the highest since the break-up of Yugoslavia in 1992. item.description: A 5,610-acre section of Hendrie Ranch will remain undeveloped due to a $12.9 million conservation easement.
